titulo_es: Dear Louise, thank you for the last time.

texto: **Kære** and **Hej** can open a mail; **Knus** is a close farewell. See who writes and what question before interpreting an isolated sentence.
**Tak for sidst** refers to a recent shared occasion.

**Stiger** (up), **falder** (low) and **er stort set uændret** (remains almost the same) describe different changes. Before summarizing, it identifies which variable is measured and during which period.
**Alt i alt viser tallene, at …** introduces a general conclusion, which should correspond to the data.

filas: Alt i alt viser tallene, at cyklen bliver mere populær.

frases.es: Querida Louise, ¡gracias por la última vez!
frases.en: Dear Louise, thank you for the last time!
analisis: Thank you for the last time.

frases.da: Jeg har læst din anmeldelse af bogen.
frases.es: He leído tu reseña del libro.

frases.da: Hvad synes du om den nye bil?
frases.en: What do you think of the new car?

frases.da: Jeg svarer gerne, hvis du vil vide det.
frases.es: Te contesto con gusto, si quieres saberlo.
frases.en: I'm happy to answer, if you want to know.

frases.da: Antallet af cyklister stiger hvert år.
frases.es: El número de ciclistas sube cada año.
frases.en: The number of cyclists goes up every year.

frases.es: El precio de los coches baja un poco.
frases.en: The price of cars is a little low.

frases.da: Brugen af bussen er stort set uændret.
frases.es: El uso del autobús está prácticamente igual.
frases.en: The use of the bus is almost the same.

frases.da: Alt i alt viser tallene, at cyklen bliver mere populær.
frases.es: En resumen, las cifras muestran que la bici es cada vez más popular.
frases.en: In short, the figures show that the bike is becoming more and more popular.
